messages:
Morgan: Starting change window for embed-service (eu-west). Rolling canary 0% -> 20% over 20m. Deploy-bot scheduled at 2026-03-23T23:15Z, watch p95 and 5xx.
Deploy-bot: rollout-start | service=embed-service region=eu-west canary=20% window=20m id=cb-1768519999 :rocket:
obs-bot: heads-up: p95 increased 180ms -> 520ms in last 4m, 5xx rose 0.1% -> 0.7%. Dash: https://redwood.obsv/d/embed-service?range=10m :eyes:
Alex: confirming on traces, tail latency spikes on rerank path when batch size=1 and KV-cache miss.
Priya: can we pause the ramp and pin canary traffic back to v2.14.0 for eu-west while we triage? Prefer scope=canary so prod stays on new version for other regions.
Morgan: agreed. Pause and pin for canary only. Keep 0% ramp to 20% paused.
Alex: command to run:
```
# pin canary traffic back to previous build
deployctl pin --service embed-service --region eu-west --scope canary --from v2.15.0 --to v2.14.0
```
Priya: ran the pin; deploy-bot acknowledged.
Deploy-bot: action=pin completed | service=embed-service region=eu-west scope=canary target=v2.14.0 user=Priya ts=1768520042 :white_check_mark:
obs-bot: post-pin snapshot: p95 decreased to 290ms in ~2m, 5xx returned to 0.16%. We'll keep sampling for 15m.
Jamie: thanks. Marking change window as paused and adding note to release notes. I'll open an RCA/Triage card assigned to Alex + Priya and ping oncall.
Morgan: release notes updated: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-23-embed-v2.15.0-changes. Change window status: PAUSED. Oncall pinged: @oncall-eu :triangular_flag_on_post:
Alex: starting local repro with same batch shapes & TTL. If this reproduces, sharing a minimal diff and a candidate revert. Could be KV TTL behavior or a kernel optimization mismatch.
Priya: running perf harness on staging with reduced KV TTL + single-item batches, will post results in 20m.
obs-bot: adding this thread to the deployment watchlist and annotating charts with pin action for auditors.
Jamie: operational decision: hold until root cause identified or metrics stable for 60m. If we see another regression we rollback globally.
Morgan: agreed. If we need to roll forward a patched v2.15.x we will coordinate a canary-only patch before global release. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
